record.name: 1500 Owens Street
names: UCSF Orthopaedic Institute at Mission Bay
record.summary: A six-story office/lab/retail building (per its building permit) at 1500 Owens Street in Mission Bay South, housing the UCSF Orthopaedic Institute and a UCSF Health Radiology (musculoskeletal imaging) clinic. The 42,000 sq ft UCSF Orthopaedic Institute was completed here in 2009 (architect Nacht & Lewis, who describe the project as an outpatient clinical facility with an ambulatory surgery center, radiology suite and academic offices), DBI shows the building permit completed on July 31, 2009, and DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the parcel's construction year as 2009. A UCSF news release is cited for an opening date of October 1, 2009 (see open questions).

Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8709018)); 100% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 62% of the lot.

open_questions: Architect and general contractor not confirmed by any source found as of 2026-09-21.

Whether the other clinics now at this address (Sports Medicine, Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation, Gynecology & Urogynecology) opened at the same time as the Orthopaedic Institute or moved in later is not established.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot (block 8709, lot 006) differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 018); DataSF's Assessor parcel records show lot 006 retired and lot 018 (address 1500 Owens) created on the same date, 2009-04-08 (record add and drop dates), and the address, 6-story office/lab/retail description, and 2009 permit-completion date all line up with lot 018, so the permit lot is treated as having been replaced by lot 018, not as a different building. Whether lot 018 is a one-to-one renumbering or a piece of the larger old lot is not stated in the records read.

Sports Medicine, Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation, Orthopedic Surgery Center and Gynecology & Urogynecology clinics were removed from the summary: the only page read for this address (UCSF Health's Radiology page) lists Radiology (Musculoskeletal Imaging) alone. Other UCSF Health location pages may list them.

The UCSF news release (2009-10) cited for the Orthopaedic Institute's October 1, 2009 opening and its being UCSF's first clinical service at Mission Bay refused access when checked on 2026-10-12 (also a second UCSF page and two other ucsf.edu pages), so the exact day and the \"first clinical service\" wording are unchecked; the record shows 2009 only. DBI's permit shows the building complete on 2009-07-31 and the architect's page gives 2009.
